cues.text: On the Moonlight Bridge, its roadway smeared with blood, Takaya stands at ease: gaunt and bare-chested, long silver-grey hair held back by a thin circlet, serpent tattoos winding down both arms, faded flared jeans on a studded belt. Jin strides up beside him in his bright green high-collared jacket and orange-tinted glasses, a metal attache case swinging from one hand, and drops into a wide, ready stance. Behind them, before the full moon, hangs their Shadow: a massive grey-green brute strung beneath a steel girder like a carcass on a crane, arms stretched straight out as a cross, ragged sky-blue wings sprouting from the beams above him. You and Aigis face them.
